title: They quit their day jobs to bet on current events. A look inside the prediction market mania
summary: Prediction market apps are thriving in Trump's second term, with traders betting on migrant deportations to election outcomes. A community of young, mostly male and very online traders are driving the industry's bonanza.
contentText:
